svg.title: pySEB: from analytical and PDB subunits to expressions, visualization, and fitted scattering
svg.desc: Install pySEB; choose analytical or custom models, parse PDB files into numerical clouds, and optionally include excluded solvent and hydration. Connect named reference points in Python, nest structures, and save topology. The assembly branches to symbolic expressions and SymPy, direct numerical evaluation, 3D visualization through OpenUSD and Blender, or the SasView ecosystem through the Python sasmodels adapter. Direct evaluation feeds both plotting and parameter fitting. The plotted curves use the same cloud-cylinder-sphere assembly at three sphere radii.
svg.text: Optional extras: 3D visualization and SasView tools
Analytical models and numerical clouds can be mixed.
Use clouds with or without hydration.

g.text: Connect named attachment points in Python.
